requirements.description: The multi-agent workflow must route a user task through the declared agents (user_proxy, researcher, research_manager, director) and terminate within the configured max_turns or upon a TERMINATE signal.
expected_behavior: group_chat_manager routes messages among all registered agents
agents collaborate to complete the research task
conversation terminates via TERMINATE message or max_turns limit
negative_cases: empty user input causes immediate termination without agent interaction
conversation exceeds max_turns without producing a result
agent fails to respond, causing infinite loop or timeout

expected_behavior: researcher invokes web_scraping and google_search to gather16 information

requirements.description: awn The group chat manager must enforce speaker selection and turn-taking so that only one agent speaks at a time and the conversation follows a logical order.
expected_behavior: group_chat_manager selects the next speaker based on the conversation context
only the selected agent generates a response
all agents have the opportunity to contribute
speaker selection prevents infinite loops between two agents
negative_cases: speaker selection gets stuck in a loop between two agents
an agent is never selected to speak despite having relevant context

requirements.description: The system must handle multi-turn conversations where agents maintain context across turns and build upon previous responses.
expected_behavior: agents reference information from earlier turns
research_manager coordinates the research process across multiple turns
director makes decisions based on accumulated research data
conversation history is preserved and accessible to all agents
negative_cases: agents lose context after a few turns and repeat questions
research_manager fails to track progress across turns
conversation history exceeds token limit and causes truncation
